# Core CI

[Back to Workflow Reference](WORKFLOWS.md#core-ci)

| Workflow                                             | Type       | Runner             | Docker | Purpose                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| ---------------------------------------------------- | ---------- | ------------------ | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [CI Detect Changes](ci-detect-changes.yml)           | Reusable   | `ubuntu-slim`      | No     | Applies external path filters and trusted-context classification.                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| [CI Codecov Upload](ci-upload-codecov.yml)           | Reusable   | `ubuntu-latest`    | No     | Uploads each suite's full LCOV to Codecov under its own flag using OIDC and only pinned external actions; informational, so no gate waits on it.                                                                                                                          |
| [CI area patch coverage](ci-area-coverage.yml)       | Reusable   | `ubuntu-latest`    | No     | Blocking patch-coverage check for one area workflow against only the `.coverage-rules.yml` rules that area owns, without OIDC.                                                                                                                                            |
| [Backend](backend.yml)                               | Standalone | inherited via uses | Mixed  | Backend area: PRs validate images read-only; merge groups publish and attest the same smoke-tested/scanned images; the `backend` job gates both paths.                                                                                                                    |
| [Web](web.yml)                                       | Standalone | inherited via uses | Mixed  | Web area: PRs validate the image without Sentry or registry writes; merge groups publish and attest it; the `web` job gates that path with the full web, Storybook, and Playwright suites.                                                                                |
| [Cloudflare Worker](cloudflare-worker.yml)           | Standalone | inherited via uses | No     | PR and merge-group Cloudflare Worker area: `static-cloudflare-worker` gates the full worker suite; the `cloudflare-worker` job gates the result.                                                                                                                          |
| [Lambdas](lambdas.yml)                               | Standalone | inherited via uses | No     | PR and merge-group Lambdas area: `static-lambdas` gates the full Lambdas suite; the `lambdas` job gates the result.                                                                                                                                                       |
| [Tooling](tooling.yml)                               | Standalone | inherited via uses | Yes    | PR and merge-group tooling area: the full ts-shared, tooling, portability and initialize smoke suites; the `tooling` job gates the result.                                                                                                                                |
| [Static](static.yml)                                 | Standalone | inherited via uses | No     | Repository-wide static analysis on every PR and merge group, in full even for docs-only changes; the `static` job is the required check.                                                                                                                                  |
| [Nightly](nightly.yml)                               | Standalone | inherited via uses | Mixed  | Daily and manual full run of every area workflow at the main tip; the safety net for main.                                                                                                                                                                                |
| [Main Backend](main-backend.yml)                     | Standalone | inherited via uses | Mixed  | Main backend tests plus trusted image reuse/fallback; only a successful `backend-deploy-intent` run dispatches centrally.                                                                                                                                                 |
| [Main Web](main-web.yml)                             | Standalone | inherited via uses | Mixed  | Main web suites, trusted image reuse/fallback, and optional OTel storage; only a successful `web-deploy-intent` run dispatches centrally.                                                                                                                                 |
| [Main Storybook](main-storybook.yml)                 | Standalone | inherited via uses | No     | Main-branch Storybook validation and static artifact build.                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| [Main Cloudflare Worker](main-cloudflare-worker.yml) | Standalone | inherited via uses | Mixed  | Main-branch Worker static checks and tests, followed by credential-free publication of the attempt-bound Wrangler bundle; successful completion is dispatched centrally to private infrastructure, which owns deployment mutation.                                        |
| [Main Lambdas](main-lambdas.yml)                     | Standalone | inherited via uses | Mixed  | Main-branch Lambda tests; successful completion is dispatched centrally to private infrastructure.                                                                                                                                                                        |
| [Main Checks](main-checks.yml)                       | Standalone | inherited via uses | No     | Main-branch tooling, shared TypeScript, and EXPLAIN ANALYZE tests; `select-main-checks` starts only the matching suite.                                                                                                                                                   |
| [Initialize Smoke Test](initialize-smoke-test.yml)   | Reusable   | `ubuntu-latest`    | Yes    | Verifies `./dev/initialize` setup paths.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| [Static Code Analysis](static-code-analysis.yml)     | Both       | `ubuntu-latest`    | No     | Runs cross-repo lint, formatting, dependency, shell, and repository policy checks for the `static` area workflow.                                                                                                                                                         |
| [Static Checks](checks-static.yml)                   | Reusable   | `ubuntu-latest`    | No     | Backend, web, Lambda, and Cloudflare Worker typecheck/build/smoke gates. Each PR or merge-group area workflow calls it separately so one area's static failure blocks only its related tests; grouped main workflows call the same reusable workflow once for their area. |
| [EXPLAIN ANALYZE](explain-analyze.yml)               | Reusable   | `ubuntu-latest`    | Yes    | Runs seeded identity, plan-shape, and resource-pressure regression gates.                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
